messages:
Marta: Quick heads-up — vendor updated ETAs for the EU H100 top-off. They can air-ship 40 units on 2026-04-06 (AWB GB123456789) and move the remaining 80 by sea on 2026-04-14. Reason: insurance cap on the forwarder + packaging shortage. They also flagged ~6 DOA samples; proposing RMA preflight now and consolidated returns later. Need decision on split shipments, insurance surcharge, and depot acceptance windows.

vendor-linda: Sorry for the churn — thermal foam shortage hit our pack line. We can cover courier for DOA samples, but there's an insurance surcharge of +€2,400. Air AWB: GB123456789. Serial manifest sent to Marta privately. We can rebook additional units to air if PO amendment/deposit confirmed by EOD.

Samir: If we accept 40 air + 80 sea, will that break our build cadence? Sea arriving 4/14 probably misses this week's morning builds. Can we push more to air?

Liam: :eyes: Need landed cost delta including duty, brokerage, and expedited depot handling. Can someone do a quick back-of-envelope?

Marta: rough numbers now: extra air freight ≈ +€120k for the 40, insurance +€2.4k, expedited depot handling ~€500/unit for prioritized check-in. Duty looks negligible for temporary loaners, but brokerage + port fees could add ~€3k. I'll attach a spreadsheet in the thread.

Jay: Ops note — depot acceptance window open 2026-04-08 -> 2026-04-10 (mornings). If air is 4/06 it fits. Can SRE delay non-critical builds to avoid needing all units immediately? @eng-sre

ops-bot: Depot booking confirmed: 2026-04-08 09:00 CET -> 12:00 CET (booking #D-772).

Samir: Proposal: rebook 20 of the 80 sea units to air (so final split 60 air / 60 sea). That reduces delay risk. Cost estimate add'l +€45k to rebook 20. @vendor-linda can you confirm availability?

vendor-linda: We can rebook 20 to air if deposit and amended PO are signed by EOD. We'll update AWB and provide new airwaybills. RMA labels for the 6 DOA will be issued and courier pickup can be arranged for 2026-04-09.

Marta: Decision path for this thread: 1) Approve rebook 20->air, 2) Approve insurance surcharge (+€2.4k), 3) Proceed with RMA preflight for 6 DOA. Finance needs an emergency PO amendment to unlock rebook.

Finance Squad: We see the numbers; prepare a PO change doc with the updated line items and cost center. We'll prioritize EOD processing if Marta drops the draft here.

Liam: Approve on cost. Please cc me on PO draft.

vendor-linda: Confirming: we'll send amended manifest and airwaybills for the 60-air plan by EOD once PO confirmation arrives. RMA labels for 6 DOA will follow, courier pickup 2026-04-09.

Marta: Thanks — I'll draft PO change now and ping finance. Once AWB updates are in, I'll post the final tracking. :thumbsup:
